title: Generate a reference character sheet with GPT Image 2, then attach it as an…
content:
Generate a reference character sheet with GPT Image 2, then attach it as an Omni Reference in Seedance 2.0 to animate the character consistently.  
Include the prompt phrase intense movement all accross the scene to make the animation feel more engaging.
